title: Finite-stage Verdier biduality
statement:
Let $Y$ be a separated finite-type scheme over
$k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, and let $A=A_{E,n}$.
On either the small etale site or the small pro-etale site,

$$
D_Y=R\mathcal Hom_A(-,\omega_Y),\qquad \omega_Y=Ra_Y^!A,
$$

is a contravariant exact anti-equivalence of $D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$,
and the natural map $\delta_K:K\to D_YD_YK$ is an isomorphism.
No boundary duality input is a hypothesis of this theorem.

proof.text: Apply thm-weil-etale-geometric-biduality with the given structure morphism to obtain the unchanged ordinary-etale conclusion. Equip Y with the Over structure whose structure morphism is exactly aY.

Specialize lem-weil-finite-duality-site-comparison at Y. Unpack its fixed dualizing-object comparison data to obtain the pro-etale ambient pairing hPro, the anti-equivalence d on the finite-Tor constructible full subcategory, its natural inclusion comparison c with the specified ambient internal-Hom functor, and invertibility of its specified bidualityMap. These are clauses of the existing comparison statement; no new transport theorem is assumed.

Finite-Tor constructibility is invariant under isomorphism: map the isomorphism through the canonical intrinsic realization; use the existing finite-torsion constructibility isomorphism-closure instance, and keep the same Tor interval. For the Tor clause compose every representative isomorphism Q(M) ≅ L with the inverse of K ≅ L, so the unchanged tests reduce to those for K. For each K in the full subcategory, the component c_K identifies the underlying object d(K) with its ambient Verdier dual, giving preservation.

Apply lem-weil-native-internal-hom-contravariant-exact to the Grothendieck abelian category of fixed-scalar pro-etale module sheaves and to the specified pro-etale dualizing object. Its coherent shift structure and IsTriangulated assertion give the required explicit image distinguished triangle by Functor.map_distinguished. Pair this exactness with d and c, and retain hPro and its canonical biduality-map invertibility unchanged.
